investment_strategy: Barbell across A.I. platforms and semiconductor picks-and-shovels for the next 12–36 months. Overweight a lower-volatility platform leader (Microsoft) for stability and durable A.I. monetization; add a high-growth, fast-momentum platform (Alphabet) for upside; and take a measured position in a critical semiconductor enabler (ASML) to capture the data-center and lithography supercycle. Emphasize risk control via position sizing, quarterly rebalancing, and monitoring of antitrust, export controls, and capex-cycle headlines.
